properties.title: Venezuela Twin Earthquakes M7.5+M7.2
properties.summary: Two M7.5 and M7.2 quakes 39s apart near Veroes, Yaracuy. 2,595+ dead, 12,400+ injured, ~50,000 unaccounted for.

properties.title: Typhoon Bavi-26 (Red Alert)
properties.summary: Super typhoon forecast 161mph by July 5. Track: Mariana Islands (July 7), then Taiwan/Ryukyus.

properties.title: Tropical Cyclone Maysak-26 (Orange Alert)
properties.summary: Category 1 cyclone in South China Sea approaching Vietnam coast.

properties.title: Ukrainian drone strike: Ufa NPC (Bashkortostan)
properties.summary: Ukrainian drones hit 2 refineries and a fuel depot in Ufa, Bashkortostan - 1,500km from front. Fire confirmed.

properties.title: Ukrainian drone strike: Poltavskaya oil depot (Krasnodar)
properties.summary: Third strike on Poltavskaya oil depot in June. Fire confirmed.

properties.title: Ukrainian drone strike: Orenburg Gas Processing Complex
properties.summary: Strike on Orenburg GPC - one of world's largest gas-chemical complexes.

properties.title: Russian missile/drone attack on Kyiv
properties.summary: 70+ missiles, 500+ drones. 18 killed, 90+ injured. Apartments, hotel, research institute hit.

properties.title: Japan Earthquake M6.1
properties.summary: M6.1 earthquake near Okinawa, 560,000 people in MMI IV zone.

properties.title: Indonesia Earthquake M6.2
properties.summary: M6.2 earthquake, North Maluku. 720,000 in MMI IV zone. Depth 121km.

properties.title: Russia Earthquake M5.9 (Sakhalin region)
properties.summary: M5.9 depth 76km. Green GDACS alert, few people affected.

properties.title: France: First Ebola case in Europe
properties.summary: Humanitarian doctor returning from DRC tested positive. Contact tracing underway. DRC outbreak: 1,048 cases, 267 dead.

properties.title: Sudan: Ongoing RSF-SAF conflict
properties.summary: Civil war continues. RSF controlling Darfur and Khartoum suburbs. 180+ killed in last 30 days.

properties.title: Gaza: Ongoing conflict
properties.summary: Israeli operations continue post-Iran ceasefire. ~340 civilian deaths in last 30 days.

properties.title: Crimea: Power cuts after strikes
properties.summary: Sevastopol declared 'temporary power restriction regime'. Power outages across Crimea following Ukrainian strikes.

properties.title: Portugal: Active forest fire
properties.summary: Green GDACS alert for forest fire in central Portugal.
